"''Yes, commander.|Pyre and the tech stormtrooper, on CB-23|}} A [[human]] individual served as a '''tech stormtrooper''' in the [[First Order]] In [[34 ABY]], the [[tech stormtrooper]] was part of a contingent of [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] that escorted [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] and [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] to the [[planet]] [[Varkana]] in search of [[Resistance]] agents. They electrocuted the captured Resistance [[BB-series astromech droid]] [[CB-23]] to get her to reveal the location of the Resistance agents. After the [[trooper]] had gained access to the [[droid]]'s [[databank]], Tierny ordered them to retrieve the droid's information and then destroy her. However after Tierny left, CB-23 latched a cable onto the tech stormtrooper's backpack, electrocuting and knocking them unconscious. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|Breakout}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:First Order stormtroopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
